correction_to_earlier_triage: No new cast-color history tracker is justified by current source. CastSpellHandler already records cast-time colors/types/face-down state in spellsCastThisTurnByPlayer, and DynamicAmount.SpellsCastThisTurn supports Player.EachOpponent through getOpponents. Compose CompareAmounts(count matching blue OR black, GTE,1). Do not use Player.AnOpponent, which resolves only the first opponent, or PlayerCastSpellsThisTurn with EachOpponent, which its single-player condition evaluator does not resolve.
reusable_capabilities: Existing cast record matcher handles recursive OR color predicates and excludes face-down printed identity from colored matches.
Existing turn reset clears cast records. Copies not cast do not create records; copied cards actually cast should.
Existing GrantSpellsCantBeCountered player component and stack checks are a plausible current/future spell grant; verify current control semantics and counter-spell riders.

Existing per-permanent floating HEXPROOF_FROM_COLOR keywords handle color-restricted protection from opposing targeting. Capture affected permanents at resolution, not a continuous filter affecting later arrivals.
remaining_source_gaps: Current player hexproof component/query is blanket, not source-color scoped. GrantEvasionKeywordEffect currently supports only blanket hexproof/shroud for players.

Colored player hexproof must use one common source-aware decision across legal enumeration, TargetFinder and validation/revalidation, and expose truthful client text. Do not approximate with protection from colors, which would wrongly prevent damage.

Reuse existing evasion/protection vocabulary with a reviewed optional qualifier or equally justified minimal extension; preserve all23 goldens and82 historical serialized fixtures. No card-name branch.
Spell controller lookup currently prefers SpellOnStackComponent.casterId. Verify the engine's control-change convention before claiming spells-you-control semantics.
Duration stacking/removal must preserve unrelated permanent or longer-duration grants.
proposed_semantic_cases: No qualifying opponent cast: no draw; remaining effects still apply.
Blue spell cast by any opponent, including non-first multiplayer opponent: draw1.
Black spell cast by any opponent: draw1.
Multiple qualifying casts and blue-black spell: draw exactly1.
Own blue/black casts only: no draw.
Resolved, countered and currently stacked qualifying opponent casts count.
Uncast spell copies and activated/triggered abilities do not count as casts.
Face-down blue/black printed card does not count as colored cast.
Next-turn reset removes prior-turn cast qualification.
Veil can itself be countered before resolving.
Already-controlled spells and later-controlled spells cannot be countered after resolution.
Countering spell still targets legally and retains additional riders.
Spell copies are protected but activated/triggered abilities remain counterable.
Own blue/black sources may target protected player/permanents.
Opponents' blue/black/multicolored sources cannot target protected player or affected permanents.
Opponents' red/green/white/colorless sources remain eligible.
A source leaves before its ability resolves: use correct source characteristics/LKI.
Blue/black nontargeted damage/effects are not prevented by hexproof.
Permanents entering after resolution do not receive this fixed affected-set grant.
Blinking an affected permanent does not carry the old-object grant.
Control changes use the correct current spell/permanent controller.
End-of-turn cleanup and overlapping duration grants.
Saved-state round trips and client/legal-action parity.
execution_order: After current observer and planned counter/Metamorph qualification, derive exact card/primitive draft and preregistration; no additional build is dispatched during this review.
